name: Create ranked editorial content digests from RSS feeds with email and CSV

parameters.content:
## Find daily content ideas from RSS with ranked briefs, email digests and CSV exports

### How it works

This workflow runs on a daily schedule or manually to collect articles from configured RSS feeds, normalize them, and rank them into content opportunities. It balances the shortlist, builds editorial planning prompts, renders an HTML digest with source-health diagnostics, then creates downloadable CSV/HTML outputs. If enabled, it emails the digest; otherwise it keeps the generated digest local for manual review.

### Setup steps

- Configure the RSS feed URLs, ranking keywords, digest limits, recipient settings, and email toggle in the Set Digest Parameters node.
- Set the schedule trigger to the desired send time and timezone if 09:00 UTC is not appropriate.
- Add valid email/SMTP credentials to the Email Digest to Editorial node if email delivery will be used.
- Test with the Manual Trigger Digest Preview manual trigger before enabling the scheduled run.

### Customization

Adjust the scoring and balancing logic, feed validation rules, CSV fields, email recipients, and digest template to match the editorial team's priorities.

## Start and configure digest

Manual and scheduled entry points feed into the digest configuration and initial feed-list expansion, setting the run parameters before articles are collected.

## Read and normalize feeds

Reads each RSS source and converts feed items into a consistent article format while capturing diagnostics about source health.

## Rank and brief ideas

Scores, filters, and balances candidate articles, then turns the ranked opportunities into editorial planning prompts and brief inputs.

## Render source-aware digest

Builds the final digest view, combining ranked opportunities, planning details, and source-health information before branching to exports and delivery.

## Export shortlist CSV

Prepares a compact ranked shortlist CSV and converts it into a downloadable file.

## Export decision ledger

Creates a fuller decision ledger CSV with the underlying scoring and review data, then converts it into a downloadable file.

## Download HTML Digest

Converts the rendered HTML digest into a local downloadable artifact for previewing or archiving.

## Email or keep local

Checks whether email delivery is enabled, then either sends the editorial digest or records that the digest should remain local.

## Before publishing

- No paid AI or search API is required. Hosting and optional SMTP-provider costs may apply.
- Email is OFF by default. Test manually before scheduling.
- Read trusted public feeds only; RSS Read may follow redirects.
- Keyword scoring is designed for English/ASCII terms. Scores do not measure popularity.
- Duplicates are removed within this run only. Stories may appear on later days.
- Editorial prompts are planning aids, not article summaries. Read the original source, verify claims and credit it before publishing.
- Code and graph fixtures passed; full n8n and SMTP acceptance still need testing in your instance.
- Source errors and empty results remain visible in diagnostics.
